quote: SVIT gave me the foundation and courage to build a career in Silicon Valley. The mentors here shape not just careers, but character.
The entrepreneurship cell at SVIT set me on the path of building my own company. Two decades on, I still return every year to mentor students.

I thank SVIT and the faculty for all the efforts put in by them. Along with perseverance and right moves, they have helped me succeed. All my batch mates are doing well in their respective jobs which reflects the quality of students the institute has produced.

I had an enriching experience at SVIT. I am thankful to all my professors and my department for helping me sharpen my skills. It was a perfect blend of joy and hardships that truly prepared me for the professional world.

Being part of the first batch of Aeronautical Engineering in Gujarat, we had a wonderful journey of four years. The institute and faculty provided all possible support to ensure we received the best engineering education in the Aeronautical Engineering field.

Years ago, I walked into SVIT with nothing but ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. Today, I stand here as the recipient of the Best Alumni Award. This award is a reminder that success is never an individual journey — it takes a village, and SVIT was mine.
